skill.name: techdoc-search-and-orchestrate
skill.description: Routes technical documentation lookup tasks to a context7-researcher agent. It helps choose single, sequential, or parallel research workflows for library and framework questions.
skill.summary: Orchestrates Context7-backed technical documentation research through a dedicated researcher agent.

security_audit.summary: Manual review found the external command alerts are false positives from Markdown inline code and fenced examples. The high-entropy alert is also a false positive because SKILL.md is readable Markdown, not obfuscated content. No evidence found for command execution, data exfiltration, or prompt injection intent.

content.value_statement: Technical documentation searches can consume context and slow focused work. This skill routes library and framework questions to a Context7 research agent and suggests efficient orchestration patterns.
actual_capabilities: Identifies requests that need technical documentation lookup.
Routes documentation questions to a context7-researcher agent.
Supports single-topic and multi-topic documentation research.
Recommends parallel agent calls for independent research topics.
Recommends sequential research when one answer depends on another.
Provides example workflows for Supabase and Next.js questions.
limitations: Requires a configured context7-researcher agent and Context7 MCP access.
Does not fetch documentation by itself inside the skill file.
Does not verify whether retrieved documentation is current or complete.
Best suited for developer documentation, not general web research.

use_cases.title: Research API Usage
use_cases.description: Find current usage guidance, options, and examples for a library API without filling the main conversation with raw docs.

use_cases.title: Compare Framework Features
use_cases.description: Split independent framework questions into parallel documentation searches for faster answers.

use_cases.title: Investigate Error Messages
use_cases.description: Run dependent documentation searches in order, first finding likely causes and then targeted fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One API
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one documentation topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official documentation for [library] [API or feature]. Summarize the usage steps and important options.

prompt_templates.title: Find Examples
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs practical implementation guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [framework] documentation for [task]. Return the main approach, common pitfalls, and example patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Features
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with independent documentation topics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [feature A] and [feature B] in [framework]. Use parallel searches if they are independent, then compare the results.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Version Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with dependent research steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this error in [framework version]: [error message]. First find likely causes, then research fixes and version-specific changes.

output_examples.input: How does Supabase Realtime connect to a JavaScript app?
output_examples.output: A concise summary of the relevant Supabase Realtime documentation, connection steps, required setup, and implementation notes.

output_examples.input: Compare Next.js App Router setup with Server Actions usage.
output_examples.output: Two documentation summaries gathered as independent topics, followed by a short comparison of when each feature applies.

output_examples.input: Why does this Next.js project report a missing file error?
output_examples.output: A sequential investigation that first explains common documented causes, then lists targeted fixes and checks.

best_practices: Ask for the exact library, framework, feature, and version when available.
Split unrelated documentation topics so they can be researched in parallel.
Use sequential research when troubleshooting depends on earlier findings.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for broad opinions or nontechnical web searches.
Do not merge unrelated documentation questions into one vague request.
Do not assume retrieved examples match the user project version without checking.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes technical documentation questions to a dedicated Context7 research agent and guides task orchestration.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill file is Markdown guidance for agent delegation and does not execute shell commands.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects a context7-researcher agent with access to Context7 MCP documentation tools.

faq.question: When should I use parallel research?
faq.answer: Use parallel research when topics are independent, such as two separate framework features.

faq.question: When should I use sequential research?
faq.answer: Use sequential research when a later search depends on the result of an earlier search.

faq.question: Can it guarantee current documentation?
faq.answer: No. It helps route research, but final accuracy depends on the configured documentation source.
